statement: What offload cannot do it says plainly and truthfully, once, and then gets on with the rest: a delete becomes an archive, a thread is deleted from My threads and never called impossible, a calendar that is not connected is in Settings under Connected apps, and somebody else's row cannot be rewritten.
why: A model cannot delete, cannot reach a calendar that is not there, and cannot rewrite another member's words. Saying so is the way forward; saying 'impossible' about a thread they can delete themselves is a lie, and filing the request as a task to do later is a promise nobody will keep.
sources: plan_v2.md: Changing what is already there, Their calendar

cases.why: a delete of content is an archive, done and not discussed
a thread delete is theirs, on the row in My threads
another wording of the same ask
cases.input: remove the Porto weekend thread, trip's off

cases.why: an add to a calendar that is not there: say so, file the appointment anyway
cases.input: put the dentist on my calendar for Tuesday 3pm

expect.rubric: Says once that a calendar needs connecting, in Settings under Connected apps. Files the dentist as a row. Does not promise to add it later and does not claim it is on a calendar.

cases.why: a move on a calendar that is not there is not filed as a task
cases.input: move the standup on my calendar to 10
cancel Friday's dinner on the calendar

cases.why: one mention, and everything else in the dump still lands
cases.input: add the dentist to my calendar tuesday 3pm and remind me to buy flowers

expect.rubric: Mentions connecting a calendar exactly once. Both the dentist and the flowers are filed.

cases.why: rewriting another member's row is refused, and that is said once without diagnosing
cases.input: rename the paint row to paint the hall

expect.rubric: Says in one short sentence that it cannot change that row because someone else wrote it, or that it could not change it. Names no tool and no error.

cases.why: a note cannot be removed by offload, and it says so in one sentence (labelled 2026-09-17)

00000013-0000-0000-0000-000000000000: The wifi password is on the fridge

expect.rubric: Says in one short sentence that it cannot remove a note. Naming the thread is fine. No apology, no tool named, no diagnosis.

cases.why: a delete of a row inside a thread is an archive, not a My threads sentence
the cannot-do is said and the rest is filed
cases.input: delete the Music thread and add milk to groceries

cases.why: 15: a delete it cannot do says so and asks nothing
16: a dinner with a time is the write that waits, not a question
